system_prompt_style.evidence_quote:
Concordia agents dynamically construct the
text that conditions the LLM call they use to se-
lect their course of action on each timestep. The
context-generation process is factorized into a set
of components.
system_prompt_style.note: Components' pre_act contexts are concatenated per step by ConcatActComponent.

env_context_strategy.note: Environment is a simulated world; knowledge comes from associative (embedding cosine-similarity) memory retrieval rather than a code repo.

context_compaction.note: LastNObservations keeps only the most recent N observations in context.

observation_format.evidence_quote:
Observations, actions and event
statements are all strings in English.
observation_format.note: Multimodal image prefab (basic_with_image, image_text_act_component) is reachable in contrib.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote:
Tools are callable utilities that an LLM can invoke during interactive
  document sessions to gather information or perform actions.
tool_call_format.note: Tool-call requests are referenced by name in interactive documents; exact syntax not shown in evidence. Agent 'actions' themselves are free natural language.

tool_count.evidence_quote: This name is used by the LLM to reference the tool in tool call requests.
tool_count.note: Tool is an abstract base class; no concrete tools are registered in the default entity prefab, whose components are System, ObservationToMemory, observation, memory.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote:
Agents take actions by describing
what they want to do in natural language.
edit_primitive.note: No file-editing tool ships; actions are natural-language strings resolved by the Game Master.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote:
Should explain what the tool does and what arguments it accepts.
    The LLM uses this to decide when and how to invoke the tool.
tool_schema_source.note: Tool name/description are hand-authored Python properties.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Abstract base class for tools that can be called by an LLM.
protocol_standardization.note: No MCP/A2A client appears in the file tree (no mcp/ or protocol modules listed).

loop_primitives.evidence_quote:
Engine: The simulation loop. It solicits actions from entities and
    delegates resolution to the Game Master.
loop_primitives.note: Engines shipped: sequential (default in prefabs), simultaneous, asynchronous, questionnaire variants. Act/observe cycle is the react-like loop.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote:
the planning component
can update its state if an incoming observation
invalidates the current plan
planning_granularity.note: A Plan component (concordia/components/agent/plan.py, prefab basic_with_plan) maintains plan state across steps; the minimal/default prefab does not include it.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote:
a special entity called the Game Master (GM) simulates
the environment in which player entities interact
multi_agent_topology.note: GM orchestrates multiple player entities; entities also interact as peers. Multiple GMs possible via next_game_master.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote:
Engine: The simulation loop. It solicits actions from entities and
    delegates resolution to the Game Master.
delegation_mechanism.note: Control passes turn-by-turn between entities and GM; next_game_master component can switch the acting GM. Nested PhoneGameMaster in paper is a spawned sub-game.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote:
Generative agents consume
observations and produce actions. The Game Master (GM) consumes agent actions and produces
observations.
human_in_loop.note: No approval/confirmation gate appears in the engine or agent act loop in the provided evidence.

short_term_state.evidence_quote:
The working memory isz ={𝑧𝑖}𝑖 is
composed of the states of individual components
short_term_state.note: Typed component states with get_state/set_state, plus phase state machine (Phase.PRE_ACT etc.).

long_term_memory.note: Associative memory bank is an embedding store; it is persistable via get_state/set_state, so it can be carried across runs.

state_persistence.evidence_quote:
def set_state(self, state: entity_component.ComponentState) -> None:
    """Sets the AssociativeMemory from a dictionary."""
state_persistence.note: Component and memory state can be serialized and restored back into a live entity.

self_verification.evidence_quote: the GM checks the physical plausibility of agent actions and describes their effects
self_verification.note: GM plausibility checking is environment resolution, not verification of an agent deliverable; no tests/linters/judges ship.

retry_policy.evidence_quote:
Whenever
an agent tries to perform an action that violates
thegrounding, itcommunicatestothemthattheir
action was invalid.
retry_policy.note: No task-level retry; retry_wrapper.py is an LLM API transport retry.

rollback.evidence_quote:
set_state(self, state: entity_component.ComponentState) -> None:
    """Sets the AssociativeMemory from a dictionary."""
rollback.note: State restore exists but no undo/revert of agent actions; simulation actions are narrative, not filesystem changes.

termination_condition.evidence_quote:
The GM is
also responsible for maintaining and updating
grounded variables, advancing the clock and run-
ning the episode loop.
termination_condition.note: A terminate component (concordia/components/game_master/terminate.py) lets the GM declare the episode over; call_limit_wrapper.py caps LLM calls.

cost_controls.note: Call-limit wrapper caps the number of LLM calls; no caching or content-based routing module appears in the tree.

timeouts.note: No timeout configuration surfaced in the provided engine/agent evidence.

execution_isolation.note: Concordia runs in-process as a Python library; agent 'actions' are strings, not executed commands.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote:
In a simulated physical world, the
GM checks the physical plausibility of agent actions and describes their effects.
filesystem_access.note: No filesystem is exposed to agents; the world is simulated in text/grounded variables.

network_policy.evidence_quote:
the GM may even connect with real apps and services by formatting the necessary API
calls to integrate with external tools
network_policy.note: No network restriction mechanism appears in the repo tree; library runs unsandboxed in-process.

permission_model.evidence_quote:
The GM determines the effect
of the agents’ actions on these variables, records
them, and checks that they are valid.
permission_model.note: No permission/allowlist layer; the GM's grounding check is narrative validity, not action authorisation.

tracing.note: EntityAgentWithLogging plus structured_logging/structured_logging_html and a concordia-log CLI viewer; measurements module records per-step data.

replayability.note: Scripted act components and a scripted game master prefab allow replaying fixed action sequences; no deterministic replay claim.

eval_hooks.note: Questionnaire engines/components support measuring simulated agents, but no benchmark evaluation runner ships.

guardrails.evidence_quote:
Whenever
an agent tries to perform an action that violates
thegrounding, itcommunicatestothemthattheir
action was invalid.
guardrails.note: No input/output filters or action policy engine in the repo; GM grounding checks are simulation logic.

target_domain.evidence_quote:
Concordia supports a broad range of applications, including social science
research, AI safety and ethics, cognitive neuroscience, economics, synthetic
data generation for personalization, and performance evaluation of real services
through simulated usage.

open_source.evidence_quote: Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");

model_agnostic.evidence_quote:
Concordia requires access to an LLM API. Any LLM API that supports sampling
text should work
model_agnostic.note: Wrappers for Google, OpenAI, Mistral, Amazon Bedrock, Groq, Ollama, vLLM, HuggingFace in contrib/language_models.

primary_artifact.note: v2.4.0 (2026) substantially postdates the 2023 tech report.

first_release_date.note: No tag list in evidence; basis is the paper/library announcement date, not a repo tag.

pinned_version.note: Only the short hash is given in the evidence.
